full_details: At first light the four words were still on the tables. Bicester by seven, then the long road to Aynho. A man binding at the road's edge told you, unasked, two for one where it should be four, and that the maltsters would have it before it was dry. You did not ask a price. About three the barley stood short in the ear, and a thunderhead stood over Edge Hill to the north-west. The last mile into Banbury wet you to the shirt in forty paces. Supper and bed were ten pence. The cheese was mostly paring. By the fire you said she speaks first, and then you let him think he does. You opened the oilcloth a finger. Nothing new was written. The sheets were dry.
one_sentence: Thunder wet you the last mile into Banbury, and the sheets in the oilcloth stayed dry.
title: Came into Banbury wet, with the sheets dry
